scope: Original Core V1 encode/apply; no Session registry receipt or successor semantics claimed.

original_linked_writer.identity: SHA-256 of the exact standalone capture executable, statically linked to the original compiled Core/model writer before the codec edits. The executable was run once to produce these fixtures and is not checked in.

source_reconstruction.limitation: Original rlib contents were not independently hashed at capture and mutable target paths may have been overwritten. The linked executable digest is the immutable original build identity; source reconstruction and byte fixtures are retained for independent review, without promising byte-identical compiler output.
